depth.h2: What Lincoln Park Homes Need From a Plumber
depth.intro: About 1 in 3 homes in Lincoln Park was built before 1940, and the neighborhood sits on one of the oldest sewer systems in the country. Whether you own a single-family home, a two-flat or a condo, those two facts shape most of the plumbing problems we see here.

tiles.title: Greystones, Two-Flats and Century-Old Drains
tiles.body: Homes from before 1940 often still have cast iron drain stacks and clay sewer lines under the basement floor. Cast iron scales up inside and cracks along the seams, and clay lets roots in at the joints. A [camera inspection](/chicago-lincoln-park/video-camera-sewer-inspections) shows the condition of your line before you decide on a [sewer repair](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-repair).

tiles.title: Combined Sewers and Basement Backups
tiles.body: Chicago’s sewers carry rainwater and wastewater in the same pipes, and most of them were built before 1930. According to MWRD, two-thirds of an inch of rain in an hour can overwhelm the system and push water back into basements. A [backflow valve](/chicago-lincoln-park/flood-control-maintenance) or an [overhead sewer](/chicago-lincoln-park/overhead-sewer-systems) keeps it out.

tiles.title: Garden Units and Ejector Pumps
tiles.body: A bathroom or laundry below the sewer line needs an [ejector pump](/chicago-lincoln-park/ejector-pump) to push wastewater up and out, and many garden units and finished basements here have one. When it fails, the basin fills fast. A yearly check of the pump, float and alarm prevents most surprises.

tiles.title: Frozen Pipes in Older Walls
tiles.body: Lake winds and long cold snaps are hard on pipes in exterior walls, back porches and unheated rooms. A pipe that splits inside a wall can leak for hours before anyone notices. We’re on call 24/7 for [burst pipe repair](/chicago-lincoln-park/burst-pipe-repair), and we can [find the leak](/chicago-lincoln-park/leak-repairs) without tearing out more than we need to.

faq.h2: Plumbing Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: How much does a plumber cost in Lincoln Park?
items.a: It depends on the job. The main factors are what’s wrong, how hard it is to reach, the parts or materials needed and the age of your plumbing. Work on a century-old drain stack can take more time than a newer system. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins, so you know the cost going in.

items.q: How fast can you get to my home in an emergency?
items.preview: Call us any time, day or night, including weekends and holidays.
items.a: Call us any time, day or night, including weekends and holidays. Our Diversey Parkway office keeps our plumbers close to Lincoln Park, and we [treat emergencies as a priority](/chicago-lincoln-park/emergency-plumbing). Arrival times depend on the day and traffic, but we’ll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why does my basement floor drain back up when it rains?
items.preview: In most of Chicago, rainwater and sewage share the same pipes.
items.a: In most of Chicago, rainwater and sewage share the same pipes. In a heavy storm, the city sewer fills up and water pushes back toward the lowest opening, which is often your floor drain. A backflow valve or an overhead sewer system stops it. Your own line can also be partly blocked, so we check that too.

items.q: My kitchen sink keeps clogging. Is it the sink or the building’s drain?
items.preview: If only the kitchen sink is slow, the clog is usually in the sink line.
items.a: If only the kitchen sink is slow, the clog is usually in the sink line. If other drains gurgle or back up when the sink drains, the problem may be in the main stack or the sewer line. We’ll find where it is and [clear it](/chicago-lincoln-park/drain-cleaning).

items.q: Do you work on two-flats and condos?
items.preview: Yes. We work for owners of single-family homes, two-flats and condo units.
items.a: Yes. We work for owners of single-family homes, two-flats and condo units. In a condo, we’ll help you figure out whether the problem is in your unit’s plumbing or a shared line, so you know who should handle it.

items.q: Can you service a gas fireplace?
items.preview: Yes. We repair gas fireplaces, check the gas line and connections for leaks and can run a new gas line for a fireplace or range.
items.a: Yes. We repair gas fireplaces, check the gas line and connections for leaks and can run a new gas line for a fireplace or range. See our [gas fireplace services](/chicago-lincoln-park/gas-fireplace).
